failure_modes: Temporal-blend or temporal-region edit injects a sign-changing observed-node rate into the reward, causing unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates with no stable level target.
Endpoint-coordinate shape contrast is diagnostic only; treating it as an affinity benefit would violate the affinity-primary objective.
No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied, so no registered choice can be shown to improve final predicted affinity.
Extrapolation beyond observed score nodes is disallowed, so any time-conditioned rule cannot be justified outside the observed window.
result.rationale: D1.2: The registered time-conditioned alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009-C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change regional attention at observed score nodes or blend the observed-node teacher into the reward; they do not change the static teacher coordinates themselves, and they are not dose-only. The delivered temporal evidence is a rate-change signal: local landmark contrast rates change sign within the observed window (first_rate_z large and negative, last_rate_z positive, multiple sign changes) with near-zero whole-window means, and polynomial fits are not accepted with extrapolation disallowed. That is a temporal derivative of the contrast, not a spatial coordinate gradient, and it is not a stable level target. D4.1: Against the incumbent (static teachers, teacher_neighbors=4, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, no temporal blend), the only endpoint-coordinate evidence is a shape-dominated integrated contrast (shape_yy/shape_xx negative, aligned shape_zz) with weak/null centroid components. This is diagnostic endpoint-coordinate contrast, not decoded terminal affinity, and the declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary. No registered choice is an affinity-head or affinity-benefit edit, and the temporal choices would inject an unstable, sign-changing observed-node rate into the reward without any demonstrated affinity advantage. The evidence therefore does not provide a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, so I retain rather than edit or defer. D4.2: Predicted failure of the temporal-blend edit: because the observed-node contrast rate flips sign inside the window, blending it (C009-C011) or re-weighting regional attention (C008) would drive unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates as the reward direction reverses, and the near-zero whole-window mean gives no stable restoring level; this is a coordinate-displacement failure, not a graph change, and it is not offset by any measured affinity gain. Affinity-first priority plus the absence of affinity labels keeps the incumbent.
